title: Agents file assembles selected built-in methodologies
description:
As a team adopting Kanbus, I want CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md assembled from the methodologies I select, so that Kanbus core carries no process opinions of its own.

```gherkin
Feature: Built-in methodologies in the generated agents file
  Scenario: Default methodologies when none are configured
    Given a Kanbus project without a methodologies setting
    When I run "kanbus setup agents --force"
    Then CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md should contain "## The Rite of Gherkin"
    And CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md should contain "## Git Flow"

  Scenario: An empty methodology list yields core guidance only
    Given a Kanbus project with methodologies set to an empty list
    When I run "kanbus setup agents --force"
    Then CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md should contain "## The Order of Being"
    And CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md should not contain "Gherkin"

  Scenario: Selected methodologies render in configured order
    Given a Kanbus project with methodologies "git-flow, bdd"
    When I run "kanbus setup agents --force"
    Then "## Git Flow" should appear before "## The Cognitive Framework" in CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md

  Scenario: Unknown methodology names fail clearly
    Given a Kanbus project with methodologies "scrum-of-scrums"
    When I run "kanbus setup agents --force"
    Then the command should fail
    And stderr should contain "unknown methodology: scrum-of-scrums"
```
